adjudicated.en: To sex all of us... no, wait, to see all of us reconciled, there is one biiig puzzle to solve.
comments: Wakan vs. wakai. After all, like all good Hentai Game Protagonists(tm), he Aims for the Harem Ending(tm). And that means orgy. That, or Tanaka totally wrote that word unconsexsexsexciously and "fixed" it this way because it was fusexnnier. -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: The source slips from 'reconcile everyone' into a homophonically similar term for consensual sex, then corrects itself. 'To sex all of us' is not grammatical English and makes the speaker both agent and participant rather than preserving the slip.
adjudicated.remedy: To get everyone consensually laid... no, reconciled
